Here is your curated weekly events digest for Brisbane, **11–17 May 2026**, drawn from all the major institutional sources. All events match your WANT/PREFER criteria and nothing from the SKIP list has been included.

---

# 🗓️ Brisbane Events Digest — 11–17 May 2026

---

## 🎭 COMEDY / PERFORMANCE

---

### 1. Brisbane Comedy Festival: Jiggle Jiggle (Josh Thomas)
**Category:** Concert / Music (Stand-up Comedy)
**Date & Time:** 13–17 May
**Venue:** Brisbane Powerhouse, New Farm
**Cost:** Ticketed (see website)
**URL:** https://brisbanepowerhouse.org/events/

Josh Thomas makes his return to Brisbane Comedy Festival 2026 with his new show *Jiggle Jiggle*. Described as quirky, hilarious and authentic, this is one of the headline acts of the festival's final week. The Brisbane Comedy Festival 2026 features more than 100 artists in a diverse program of over 300 events across four iconic Brisbane venues: Brisbane Powerhouse, The Tivoli, The Fortitude Music Hall and The Princess Theatre.

---

### 2. Brisbane Comedy Festival: Okay, I Believe You
**Category:** Concert / Music (Stand-up Comedy)
**Date & Time:** 13–14 May (Auslan Comedy)
**Venue:** Brisbane Powerhouse, New Farm
**Cost:** Ticketed
**URL:** https://brisbanepowerhouse.org/events/

*Okay, I Believe You* is an Auslan-interpreted comedy show running as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival. A rare chance to see accessible, inclusive comedy with strong community atmosphere at one of Brisbane's most atmospheric venues.

---

### 3. Brisbane Comedy Festival: Shad & Pete Save the World!
**Category:** Concert / Music (Stand-up Comedy)
**Date & Time:** 2–23 May (late-night raw variety)
**Venue:** Brisbane Powerhouse, New Farm
**Cost:** Ticketed
**URL:** https://brisbanepowerhouse.org/events/

*Shad & Pete Save the World!* is a late-night raw variety comedy show running as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival. An intimate, irreverent show suited to those who enjoy unpredictable, experimental comedy.

---

### 4. Brisbane Comedy Festival: Bron Lewis
**Category:** Concert / Music (Stand-up Comedy)
**Date & Time:** Sunday 17 May 2026, 6:00PM · Underground Theatre · $30 Thu / $35 Fri, Sat & Sun
**Venue:** Brisbane Powerhouse – Underground Theatre, New Farm
**Cost:** From $30 + transaction fee
**URL:** https://brisbanepowerhouse.org/events/bron-lewis/

Bron Lewis' life is complete and utter chaos, just ask her dog trainer. She has three kids and just when things couldn't get any harder, she bought a puppy. A glutton for punishment, Bron has welcomed the flourishing of her comedy career, which means she has a million plates in the air.

---

## 🎵 MUSIC / CONCERTS

---

### 5. QSO Italian Gala
**Category:** Concert / Music
**Date & Time:** Friday, 15 May 2026
**Venue:** QPAC Concert Hall, South Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed
**URL:** https://qso.com.au/events/2026/concert-specials-2026/qso-italian-gala

Experience the passion, power and drama of Italy as the Queensland Symphony Orchestra presents the Italian Gala at QPAC's Concert Hall. Under the baton of Chief Conductor Maestro Umberto Clerici, the orchestra takes audiences on a journey through the heart of Italian music — from Rossini's playful *The Barber of Seville* to the powerful intensity of Puccini and Verdi. The program features Vivaldi's Triple Concerto for violin, cello and accordion, with Clerici taking a rare solo turn on cello alongside Yoshimoto and returning world-renowned accordionist James Crabb.

---

### 6. QSO Maestro Series Preview Concerts (Wed–Thu)
**Category:** Concert / Music
**Date & Time:** 13 May 2026, 7:00 PM & 14 May 2026, 7:00 PM
**Venue:** QPAC Concert Hall, South Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed
**URL:** https://qso.com.au/events/2026/maestro-series/maestro-3-rachmaninov-and-shostakovich

Experience Rachmaninov's beloved Piano Concerto No. 2 with the Queensland Symphony Orchestra alongside Shostakovich's emotional 5th Symphony and Cathy Milliken's *Catalogue of Sky*. Two preview performances before the main Saturday Maestro Series concert.

---

### 7. QSO Maestro Series: Rachmaninov & Shostakovich (Main Night)
**Category:** Concert / Music
**Date & Time:** 16 May 2026, 7:30 PM
**Venue:** QPAC Concert Hall, South Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed
**URL:** https://qso.com.au/events/2026/maestro-series/maestro-3-rachmaninov-and-shostakovich

The headline Maestro Series concert of the week. Features Rachmaninov's beloved Piano Concerto No. 2 alongside Shostakovich's emotional 5th Symphony.

---

## 🖼️ ARTS / EXHIBITIONS

---

### 8. GOMA Friday Nights — Olafur Eliasson: Presence
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Date & Time:** 5:30–8:30 pm, Friday 15 May 2026
**Venue:** Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed (exhibition entry applies)
**URL:** https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/event/goma-friday-nights-presence-2026-05-08

GOMA is open every Friday night from 1 May until 26 June, during *Olafur Eliasson: Presence*. Step into the multi-sensory art of Olafur Eliasson, meet up with friends, and enjoy drinks and delicious bites at bespoke bars. Each week, Brisbane's best selectors take over the Vinyl Listening Bar, DJs set the mood in the River Room, and live performances pop up across the gallery. A unique and unmissable night out featuring art, music and connection.

---

### 9. Olafur Eliasson: Presence — Exhibition (Open All Week)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Date & Time:** Daily (1 May – 26 June 2026), standard gallery hours
**Venue:** Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed (from $20)
**URL:** https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/

Exclusive to Brisbane, *Presence* displays major works by one of contemporary art's pre-eminent figures. From large-scale works that play with light, colour and perception to a meticulously constructed riverbed — this exhibition comes to life as we move through it and experience each moment in succession.

---

### 10. GOMA Kids Tour: Presence & Play
**Category:** Workshop / Class (Family)
**Date & Time:** 8:30–10:00 am, Saturday 16 May 2026
**Venue:** Gallery of Modern Art (GOMA), South Brisbane
**Cost:** From $19 (various family ticket options)
**URL:** https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/event/kids-tours-presence-and-play-2026-07-04

Designed for families with children, these multi-sensory tours of *Olafur Eliasson: Presence* invite you to explore art through play. Together, you'll be guided through playful experiences that immerse you in art, spark your imagination and build connection in a relaxed, family-friendly setting. Includes an exclusive exhibition viewing — experience the magic of the exhibition in a crowd-free setting before the Gallery opens to the public.

---

### 11. Australian Cinémathèque: Double Take (Ongoing Film Program)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition (Film)
**Date & Time:** 1 May – 1 July 2026 (screening times on website)
**Venue:** Australian Cinémathèque, Gallery of Modern Art, South Brisbane
**Cost:** Ticketed
**URL:** https://www.qagoma.qld.gov.au/whats-on/

The Australian Cinémathèque's *Double Take* program runs 1 May – 1 July 2026 at the Gallery of Modern Art. The Cinémathèque is GOMA's dedicated cinema space showing curated international and art house film programs — a rare opportunity for thoughtful film culture in Brisbane this week.

---

### 12. Museum of Brisbane — Permanent & Current Exhibitions (Open Daily)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Date & Time:** Open daily, standard hours
**Venue:** Museum of Brisbane, City Hall, Brisbane CBD
**Cost:** Free entry (some events require bookings)
**URL:** https://www.museumofbrisbane.com.au/whats-on/

Current exhibitions at the Museum of Brisbane include shows running through 2026, including exhibitions open from March to November 2026 and a residency program through July 2026. The museum's rooftop location in Brisbane City Hall makes it a beautiful and intellectually engaging cultural venue. Walking tours also run on select Wednesdays and Saturdays from this week.

---

### 13. Dearly Departed: Death in Life — SLQ Exhibition (Ongoing)
**Category:** Arts / Exhibition
**Date & Time:** Ongoing through Autumn 2026, open during SLQ hours
**Venue:** State Library of Queensland (SLQ), South Brisbane
**Cost:** Free
**URL:** https://www.slq.qld.gov.au/autumn

*Dearly Departed: Death in Life* engages with themes of death, dying, memory and remembrance. Tarot cards are used as visual stories about change and transformation, and a related hands-on workshop invites participants to draw on the symbolism of tarot archetypes to create their own symbolic artworks. This is a thought-provoking, free exhibition ideal for a contemplative mid-week visit.

---

## 🔬 PUBLIC LECTURES / IDEAS

---

### 14. SLQ: Underwater Soundscape Composition Workshop (Autumn Series)
**Category:** Workshop / Class
**Date & Time:** Check SLQ website for specific May dates
**Venue:** State Library of Queensland (The Edge), South Brisbane
**Cost:** Check website
**URL:** https://www.slq.qld.gov.au/autumn

Dive beneath the surface of the Brisbane River and discover a hidden world of sound. In this hands-on workshop led by sound artist and researcher Dr Leah Barclay, participants will explore the art and science of underwater listening and create their own original soundscape composition. Listening provides access to a non-invasive way of understanding hidden aquatic worlds. A genuinely rare intersection of science, art and environmental thinking.

---

### 15. Queensland Museum Lunchtime Lectures (Upcoming Series)
**Category:** Public Lecture
**Date & Time:** Thursdays at lunchtime (next: 28 May; check for any May additions)
**Venue:** Queensland Museum Kurilpa, South Brisbane
**Cost:** Free
**URL:** https://www.museum.qld.gov.au/kurilpa/whats-on/lunchtime-lectures/

Bring a bite to eat and an appetite for knowledge as Queensland Museum staff give you a glimpse into their research and what they've been working on. Upcoming topics include the restoration of the Ipswich Signal Cabin and, in late May, *Technologies of the Body: Women and Visibility in Museum Collections*. Check the museum website for any unannounced May 14 edition.

---

## 🌿 OUTDOOR / ADVENTURE / COMMUNITY

---

### 16. Redlands Coast AdventureFest (Starts This Week!)
**Category:** Community / Other (Outdoor Adventure)
**Date & Time:** 15–24 May 2026
**Venue:** Redlands Coast (various outdoor locations, ~45 min from Brisbane CBD)
**Cost:** Free community event
**URL:** https://visit.brisbane.qld.au/whats-on/whats-on-this-week

Now in its second year and hosted by Ranger Stacey, this free community event features a huge range of activities and adventures for all ages. Enjoy adrenaline-pumping experiences, hands-on kids' activities, sports demonstrations, interactive displays, information stalls and giveaways. With more than 100 events and experiences to choose from, there's something for everyone. A genuinely nature-focused, outdoorsy community event — great for adventure-minded people.

---

### 17. Museum of Brisbane — City Walking Tours (Wednesdays & Saturdays)
**Category:** Community / Other
**Date & Time:** Wednesdays + Saturdays (this week: Wed 13 & Sat 16 May), bookings essential
**Venue:** Departing Museum of Brisbane, Brisbane CBD
**Cost:** Bookings required (check website for pricing)
**URL:** https://www.museumofbrisbane.com.au/whats-on/

The Museum of Brisbane runs regular guided city walking tours that explore the history, architecture and hidden stories of Brisbane's CBD. A recurring community event ideal for curious, conversation-loving participants.

---

### 18. Museum of Brisbane — Select Sundays Walking Tours
**Category:** Community / Other
**Date & Time:** Select Sundays (Sun 17 May — check website to confirm), bookings essential
**Venue:** Departing Museum of Brisbane, Brisbane CBD
**Cost:** Bookings required
**URL:** https://www.museumofbrisbane.com.au/whats-on/

Another recurring walking tour option through Brisbane's streets, run by the Museum of Brisbane. These walking tours are listed as a recurring feature from 9 May onwards.

**⚡ Editor's Picks for the week:**
- **Friday 15 May** is the standout evening: kick off at GOMA Friday Nights (Eliasson: Presence + vinyl listening bar + live dance) at 5:30pm, then head to the QSO Italian Gala at QPAC at 7:30pm — both are within walking distance at South Bank.
- **Saturday 16 May** morning: GOMA Kids Tour (Presence & Play) at 8:30am, followed by a walk through the Eliasson exhibition during the day.
- **Comedy lovers:** Brisbane Comedy Festival's final weekend (13–17 May) is a rich hunting ground — Josh Thomas's *Jiggle Jiggle* and the Auslan-comedy *Okay, I Believe You* are particularly notable.
- **Adventurers:** The Redlands Coast AdventureFest launches this Friday (15 May) as a genuinely outdoorsy, free, community-led series of nature and adventure events.
